item.title: Self-Hosted Full-text Search Servers: Sphinx/Manticore vs Apache Solr
item.description: When your application needs fast, relevant text search — product catalogs, documentation, log analysis, or knowledge bases — you need a dedicated full-text search engine. While Elasticsearch dominates the conversation, three powerful open-source alternatives deserve serious consideration: Apache Solr, Manticore Search, and Sphinx Search.
